_comment: SystemOne scoring/ranking tuning knobs. Single source of tuning defaults — no tuning numbers are hard-coded in the implementation. Every key here can be overridden at runtime with the SYSTEMONE_* environment variable named alongside it. Choice order: router decision -> registry/config (this file) -> explicit user configuration (env).
_cost_lambda_note: Weight of model cost in expected-utility ranking: U(m) = sum_t P(t)*quality(m,t) - lambda*cost(m).
_inventory_ttl_s_note: Seconds between LM Studio model-inventory refreshes (availability marking only; never loads/unloads models).
_margin_floor_note: Top-1/top-2 calibrated margin below this marks the route uncertain (effort bump, no tool pruning).
_tool_floor_note: Minimum GLiClass relevance for a tool/MCP server to appear in ranked_tools.
_tool_kw_weight_note: Weight of keyword-overlap in hybrid tool relevance: relevance = kw_weight*kw_norm + model_weight*adj_norm.
_tool_model_weight_note: Weight of prior-adjusted model score in hybrid tool relevance.
_tool_top_k_note: Maximum tools/MCP servers returned in ranked_tools.
_tool_veto_note: Model raw score below this vetoes keyword overlap (kills keyword false positives).
_inventory_min_interval_s_note: Safety floor for inventory refresh interval (liveness guard against hammering LM Studio).
_model_top_n_note: Maximum models returned in ranked_models (null/omitted = all).
